title: Publish opens the pending-changes sheet in a confirmation posture; Changes opens it in review posture
body:
## Source

Measured on objectui main `d4bc81eab`, 2026-10-15: the shell header's Changes button and its Publish button open the same right-hand sheet, "Pending changes — What publishing will change. New items are added; updates overwrite the live version", with one collapsed row per item ("OBJECT · 1 › Ticket st_ticket · New") and a footer "Publishing releases the 1 pending draft of this package atomically · Publish all". Nothing distinguishes the two entries, so Publish is a second Changes button.

## Target

1. Publish opens the sheet in a confirmation posture: every item expanded to show what changes, a summary line above the list ("3 items · 1 object · 1 app · 1 page"), focus on Publish all.
2. Changes opens it in a review posture: items collapsed, focus on the list, the footer button present but not focused.
3. One sheet, one component, one `posture` prop.

## File surface

`packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (the pending-changes sheet and the two triggers), tests beside.

## Acceptance

1. Tests: Publish opens with rows expanded and focus on Publish all; Changes opens collapsed.
2. Screenshots of both postures, light and dark.
3. `StudioDesignSurface.*.test.tsx` green.

## Constraints

- objectui#12303: when nothing is pending, Publish stays disabled with its tooltip reason (`publish-none-reason`).
- Existing `data-testid`s (`studio-changes-count`) stay.

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-15 Studio test pass: objectui main `d4bc81eab`, HotCRM `63db83e2`, the vite console on :5180 against `objectstack serve --dev` on :4001, viewport 1482 × 1119, dark theme with a light-theme check.</sub>
